reason: A separately frozen one-replication seed matrix permits direct count and even-spacing checks if the 32-replication native event log exposes only one replication, as observed for A08.var01.
exact_seed_delta: From the frozen aggregate A08.var02 input, set Control.NREPS 32 to 1, Control.RSEED to the seed number as a string, and ProblemDescription.PDESC to a seed-specific label. Every other row and table stays unchanged.
execution: One session-0 SSH batch holds the host-wide Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue mutex for all 32 seed runs and checks GUI PID 13340 before and after each native step.

Each seed has a unique immutable versioned subdirectory with copied input, import/export/calc/jsonreport logs and files, exact source-table roundtrip, per-step record, raw SHA-256 seals and an outer source-hash-before/after closure.
Any failed native command, missing output, changed source, altered GUI, missing seed, or roundtrip mismatch fails the batch; no partial matrix is published as accepted.
predeclared_acceptance: All 32 seeds convert with zero errors and classified warnings; each one-replication report has NREP=1 and 72 aligned half-hour bins.

For each seed, the number of logged mission starts is the realized nonnegative count. For n>0, starts must equal STIM+IPER*k/n for k=0..n-1 to printed-time tolerance, with each fixed-template mission successful and complete two hours after its own start. For n=0, require no mission start or success. Reject shortage, cancellation, failure, repair and stock demand.

Each seed's reported aircraft operation exposure must equal two hours times its realized count within report-bin rounding tolerance; terminal readiness must be three aircraft. The 32 counts must include at least two distinct values.

Retain all count and start observations with seed identities. Report count sample mean, sample variance and nominal two-sided 95 percent Student-t mean half-width using 32 per-seed counts and target half-width at most one mission. This describes the fixed convenience matrix and is not proof of the Poisson law or seed independence.

Compare the seed-1 timeline with the aggregate log only as an observed same-seed consistency check. Do not treat the 32 explicit RSEED runs as the aggregate's hidden replications or force their pooled mean to equal the aggregate averaged report.
A separate read-only reviewer replays the manifest, generated source hashes, every raw closure, event counts/timings, ledgers and statistics without importing author validation.
limits: The 32 seeds form a fixed convenience matrix, not a random sample of seed values. Nominal Student-t inference presumes independent observations and cannot establish the generator's distribution or independence.
Random placement, other quantity distributions, zero period, invalid combinations, GUI visuals and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
